blocks.text: The Christmas season has officially arrived at Ayala Center Cebu, bringing with it a familiar sight that signals the start of the holidays: a towering Christmas tree, festive displays, and a mall filled with the warmth of the season. On November 13, Ayala Center Cebu welcomed the holidays with the lighting of its 52-foot Christmas tree, surrounded by a forest of 52 beautifully decorated trees. The celebration transformed the mall into a festive destination, giving shoppers and visitors another reason to pause, take in the decorations, and enjoy the Christmas atmosphere.
